analyst_view.overall: Club Brugge (9th) and Liverpool (8th) are level on 9 points, so the winner moves close to the top eight. Brugge have won their last three in Europe and won 5-1 at Mechelen on Saturday, with Nicolò Tresoldi (five Champions League goals) leading the line; Joel Ordóñez (foot, counted) and Jan Virgili (groin) are doubts. Liverpool beat Manchester United 4-0 on Sunday but lost 3-2 at Fenerbahçe last time in Europe; Ekitiké (counted), Leoni and Bradley are out, and UEFA and ESPN both now list Cody Gakpo out with a muscle injury, which the numbers do not know, while Gravenberch is a doubt. Spanish referee Alejandro Hernández Hernández (4.9 cards a game) is named and the numbers already add about 28% to cards for him. My only move since the last view is a small cut on goals for Gakpo.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals, 1.8 of them Liverpool's, already up a little for both attacks' form. Gakpo, one of Liverpool's regular scorers, is out with a muscle injury that the numbers don't list, so I take about 3% off, to about 3.3. Isak, Wirtz (five goals in his last four games) and Barcola are fit, which keeps the cut small.

corners.text: The numbers expect 9.3 corners, 6 of them Liverpool's, and already add about 5% for Liverpool's high corner count lately. Liverpool's wide play with Ngumoha and Muñoz or Barcola should look as usual even without Gakpo, and Brugge sit compact at home, so I stay at about 9.

cards.text: The numbers expect 4 cards and already add about 28% for referee Hernández Hernández, who averages 4.9 a game, plus 5% for Brugge's busy recent card count. There is no rivalry and nothing else points either way, so I stay at 4.

shots.text: The numbers say 34.8 shots and have already pushed both sides up by 15-19% for their recent shooting. Gakpo's absence changes who shoots for Liverpool more than how often, so I see no reason to move and stay at about 35.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.8 shots on target, already up about 9% for both sides' recent accuracy. Tresoldi is in form for Brugge and Liverpool still have Isak and Wirtz, so beyond the small goals cut for Gakpo I stay at about 12.
